name: Make a vertical Halloween zombie-dance clip from one cat, dog or selfie photo
tagline: One photo becomes a vertical zombie-dance video in a red leather jacket
description: AI Thriller Dance makes a 15-second vertical Halloween dance video from one photo of a cat, a dog or a person. Upload a clear photo; the subject is dressed in a red leather jacket and dances down a spooky street with two costumed kittens alongside. No prompt writing is needed. Pricing is $5 per video as a one-time purchase, no subscription. Only use photos of people or pets you have permission for.
